$comment: Bootstrap payload written to MACP_BOOTSTRAP_FILE before spawning the initiator agent of a Decision Mode run. See macp-agent-bootstrap.schema.json.
_invalid_because: initiator.session_start.extensions maps a key to a NUMBER. This schema describes the narrower, Python-compatible shape (macp-sdk-python's from_bootstrap() raises on a non-str/bytes extension value; TypeScript's reader would accept this), and RFC-MACP-0001 Section 10.3 maps protobuf bytes to base64 STRINGS in JSON, so a non-string value has no canonical reading here. Isolates the extensions VALUE subschema's type keyword.
